test_transformer_super_init: test that a transformer subclass correctly calls super().__init__() in its constructor
test_bad_transformers_caught: test that a transformer missing super().__init__() raises an AssertionError
test_all_transformers_implemented: test all registered transformer subclasses across cc_net modules call super init
test_pickle_transformer: test that a Classifier transformer can be pickled and unpickled with identical results
get_transformers_from_module: get all Transformer subclasses from a given cc_net module like dedup or tokenizer
